selection_rule: Reject failed/nonfinite/zero-gradient/inactive/explosive/saturated/pathological candidates. Prefer active objective clipping>=0.001 among healthy. Tail and drift within fixed gates define controlled/close. Select smallest LR then conventional native clip0.2 when healthy at that LR. If none active select smallest healthy LR and record inactive-clipping limitation; no post-hoc search.

interpretation_rules.GSPO_STABILITY_ONLY: Both objective-effect CIs include0 and both GSPO arms have fewer windows violating the common drift/nonfinite/inactive/ratio-tail gates than their GRPO arms. Different clip scales prevent direct clip-fraction ranking as stability proof.
interpretation_rules.NO_CLEAR_OBJECTIVE_DIFFERENCE: Both objective-effect CIs include0 and stability-only rule not met; not equivalence.
interpretation_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Incomplete evidence or discordant/mixed objective-effect CI conclusions.
